title: Graph composition with an etale first leg and open second leg
statement: For finite commutative A, noetherian schemes U, X, Z, a separated quasi-compact etale v : U → X, a quasi-compact open immersion j : X → Z, and a compactification e of v followed by j, the chosen graph comparison for v, the chosen open comparison for j, and the inverse conjugate of inverse-image composition equal compact-support composition followed by the inverse chosen compactification comparison for e and its graph comparison. All three maps have the compactifiability assumptions displayed in the Lean statement.

source.place: Tag 0F7J; etale-cohomology.tex Tag 0F4L, graph comparison with open second leg.

proof.text: Normalize the graph comparison of an open immersion using graph refinement with the identity refinement of its identity-proper compactification. Cancellation of the invertible derived graph map and the direct-image identity/composition law remove the identity proper image.

Identify localization of the exact etale adjunction with the derived open adjunction by their counits on complexes. The sum-composition counit theorem then identifies the inverse conjugate of inverse-image composition with the derived sum compositor.

Apply the existing support/sum compositor equation. Precompose with the two chosen compactification comparisons, use their naturality, and cancel them to obtain the asserted etale/open composition equation.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0F7J specialized to an open second leg, using support/sum composition and identity refinement.

theorem graph_etale_open_composition
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {U X Z : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian U] [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (v : U ⟶ X) [Etale v] [IsSeparated v] [QuasiCompact v]
    (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] [QuasiCompact j]
    [HasCompactification v] [HasCompactification j] [HasCompactification (v ≫ j)]
    (e : Compactification (v ≫ j)) :
    let s := (conjugateIsoEquiv
      (derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) (v ≫ j) inferInstance)
      ((derivedEtaleLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).comp
        (derivedOpenImmersionLowerShriekUpperStarAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j))).symm
      (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryNatIso
        (upperStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v j (v ≫ j) rfl) ≪≫
        Functor.mapDerivedCategoryCompIso _ _)
    Functor.isoWhiskerRight (graphChosenEtaleComparison A v)
        (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) j) ≪≫
      Functor.isoWhiskerLeft
        (etaleLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) v inferInstance).mapDerivedCategory
        (graphChosenOpenComparison A j) ≪≫ s =
      unboundedEtaleLowerShriekCompIso A v j ≪≫
        (rightDerivedLowerShriekIso A e).symm ≪≫
        canonicalEtaleCompactSupportComparison A (v ≫ j) e
